articles.title: Logicap buys over 38 acres near Mumbai
articles.summary: Logicap Advisors, backed by Alta Capital and a Rava Partners portfolio company, has acquired 38.5 acres of land in Bhiwandi near Mumbai. The plan is to develop a 1.3 million sq ft industrial and logistics park. This significant investment signifies ongoing infrastructure development and economic growth in the Mumbai region, pointing towards India's robust industrial sector expansion.

articles.title: Army commander visits forward post along LoC in Rajouri
articles.summary: Army's Northern Commander Lt Gen Pratik Sharma visited a forward post along the Line of Control (LoC) in J&K’s Rajouri district to review operational preparedness. He assessed the security situation and interacted with troops, emphasizing the importance of vigilance and readiness. This high-level visit underscores the Indian Army's continuous efforts to maintain robust defence and ensure national security in the sensitive border region.

articles.title: Review Indo-US trade relations, address LPG challenges amid West Asia crisis: Parl panel to govt

articles.title: India looking to join one of two European consortia developing 6th-gen fighter jets: Par Panel report

This strategic decision underscores India's commitment to bolstering its aerial capabilities. The initiative likely involves international collaboration for advanced fighter jet or engine development, reflecting a push for modernisation and self-reliance in defence.
